Propose_change_set alone.","tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":"call_00_Xg0EThr02w7jytlvztRk7681","type":"function","function":{"name":"propose_change_set","arguments":"{"changes": [{"file": "handler.ts", "content": "import { run, step } from \"zttp:durable\";\n\nstructural OrderWorkflowProof<T> = Proof<T,\n  | \"retry_safe\"\n  | \"state_isolated\"\n  | \"result_safe\"\n  | \"optional_safe\"\n  | \"input_validated\"\n  | \"pii_contained\"\n  | \"injection_safe\"\n  | \"canonical\"\n  | \"cost_bounded\"\n>;\n\nexport function handler(req: Request): OrderWorkflowProof<Response> {\n  const key = req.headers.get(\"idempotency-key\");\n  if (key === undefined) {\n    return Response.json({ error: \"missing Idempotency-Key\" }, { status: 400 });\n  }\n  return run(key, () => {\n    step(\"reserve\", () => ({ reservationId: key }));\n    step(\"charge\", () => ({ chargeId: key }));\n    return Response.json({ reserved: true, charged: true }, { status: 201 });\n  });\n}\n"}]}"}}]},"logprobs":null,"finish_reason":"tool_calls"}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":27814,"completion_tokens":710,"total_tokens":28524,"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":27648},"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":391},"prompt_cache_hit_tokens":27648,"prompt_cache_miss_tokens":166},"system_fingerprint":"aeb56401ca74e127821c4f9126dcb669"}
